title: Deputy Chris Porritt's Myers-era testimony

tellings.quote: deputy sheriff, Chris Porritt, who went on record that long before the Shermans,

plain: A deputy sheriff named Chris Porritt went on record that strange things were going on at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah ranch famous for reports of odd events, back in the 1980s when Kenneth and Edith Myers owned it, long before the Sherman family arrived. Brandon Fugal, the ranch's current owner, repeats Porritt's account. He tells it because, if true, it would mean the strange events at the ranch go back much further than the later owners.
